attributes.description: Everything scoped to a single GCS bucket. Reached by clicking a bucket in the GCP Cloud Storage Overview bucket ranking table. Apply a dashboard-level filter on resource.attributes.bucket_name to scope every panel to one bucket. Every query is also scoped to resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" since this data stream is shared with other GCP services.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Back to overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Back to overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — returns to the GCP Cloud Storage overview dashboard, carrying the current time range.
Identity strip for the bucket currently in focus. Every panel below is scoped to this bucket by the dashboard filter or the Bucket control above.
esql_query:
FROM metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
    AND resource.attributes.bucket_name IS NOT NULL
| STATS bucket_name = MAX(resource.attributes.bucket_name)
| LIMIT 1
embeddableConfig.template:
{% if rows.size == 0 %}
No bucket matches the current filters.
{% else %} {% for row in rows %}
{{ row["bucket_name"].value }}
{% endfor %} {% endif %}

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover ↗"
ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover ↗"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens this bucket's raw metric documents in Discover for the current time range.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Bucket request availability` = 100.0 * `OK Requests` / `Total Requests`
| KEEP `Bucket request availability`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Bucket request availability` = 100.0 * `OK Requests` / `Total Requests`
| KEEP `Bucket request availability`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of this bucket's API requests that returned OK over the selected range. Green at or above 99%, yellow 90–99%, red below 90%. Availability is measured per request, so on a low-traffic bucket a handful of failures moves it sharply — read it together with the total request count.
embeddableConfig.title: Bucket request availability

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED")
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Bucket client-fault request count` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Bucket client-fault request count`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED")
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Bucket client-fault request count` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Bucket client-fault request count`

embeddableConfig.description: Requests against this bucket that failed for caller-side reasons: NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, UNAUTHENTICATED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FAILED_PRECONDITION and CANCELLED. These point at the calling application or its credentials rather than at Cloud Storage.
embeddableConfig.title: Bucket client-fault request count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Bucket total request count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Bucket total request count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))

embeddableConfig.description: Total API requests against this bucket in the selected range, across all methods and response codes. Use it to judge how much weight the availability figure carries.
embeddableConfig.title: Bucket total request count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL fault_class = CASE(
    attributes.response_code == "OK", "OK",
    attributes.response_code IN ("UNAVAILABLE", "INTERNAL", "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED", "ABORTED", "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"), "service-fault",
    attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), "client-fault",
    "other"
  )
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY fault_class, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL fault_class = CASE(
    attributes.response_code == "OK", "OK",
    attributes.response_code IN ("UNAVAILABLE", "INTERNAL", "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED", "ABORTED", "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"), "service-fault",
    attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), "client-fault",
    "other"
  )
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY fault_class, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Request volume over time split into OK, client-fault and service-fault. Client-fault means Cloud Storage rejected what the caller sent; service-fault means Cloud Storage itself failed (UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, ABORTED, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) and is worth raising with Google.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket request count over time by fault class

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Method` = attributes.method

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Method` = attributes.method

embeddableConfig.description: Request volume over time broken down by Cloud Storage API method, so you can see which operations drive this bucket's traffic and when the mix changes.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket request count over time by method

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Response Code` = attributes.response_code

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Response Code` = attributes.response_code

embeddableConfig.description: Request volume over time by exact gRPC response code. Colours follow severity: green for OK, amber shades for caller-side codes, red shades for Cloud Storage-side failures.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket request count by response code over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Successful Reads` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject", `Total Reads` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.method == "ReadObject" BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Read Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`Successful Reads`) / `Total Reads`
| KEEP `Time`, `Read Availability`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Successful Reads` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject", `Total Reads` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.method == "ReadObject" BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Read Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`Successful Reads`) / `Total Reads`
| KEEP `Time`, `Read Availability`

embeddableConfig.description: Fraction of ReadObject requests that returned OK, per time bucket. Dips are read-path failures for this bucket; gaps mean there were no reads in that bucket at all.
embeddableConfig.title: Read availability over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "WriteObject"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`OK Requests`) / TO_DOUBLE(`Total Requests`)
| KEEP bucket, `Availability`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "WriteObject"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`OK Requests`) / TO_DOUBLE(`Total Requests`)
| KEEP bucket, `Availability`

embeddableConfig.description: Fraction of WriteObject requests that returned OK, per time bucket. Write failures often show up here before they are visible in the bucket-wide availability number.
embeddableConfig.title: WriteObject availability over time (OK requests / total requests)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject"
| STATS `Sent Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)
| EVAL `Latency proxy` = TO_DOUBLE(`Sent Bytes`) / `Requests`
| KEEP `Time`, `Latency proxy`
| SORT `Time`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject"
| STATS `Sent Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)
| EVAL `Latency proxy` = TO_DOUBLE(`Sent Bytes`) / `Requests`
| KEEP `Time`, `Latency proxy`
| SORT `Time`

embeddableConfig.description: Average bytes sent per ReadObject request — a proxy for object size, not latency. Cloud Monitoring publishes no request latency for Cloud Storage, so use this only to spot changes in read shape, such as many small reads replacing a few large ones.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket ReadObject latency proxy (bytes per request, not actual latency)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Ingress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/received_bytes_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Ingress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/received_bytes_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Bytes sent to clients (egress) and received from clients (ingress) over time for this bucket. Egress is normally the component that drives network cost.
embeddableConfig.title: Egress and ingress bytes over time (GCS bucket)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Stored Bytes`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Stored Bytes`

embeddableConfig.description: Most recent total stored bytes for this bucket, summed across storage classes. Storage metrics are sampled once a day, so a short time range can come back empty.
embeddableConfig.title: Total stored bytes

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Object Count`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Object Count`

embeddableConfig.description: Most recent object count for this bucket across all storage classes. Daily metric — widen the time range if it is empty.
embeddableConfig.title: Total object count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Storage Consumption` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_byte_seconds`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Storage Consumption`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Storage Consumption` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_byte_seconds`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Storage Consumption`

embeddableConfig.description: Storage consumption in byte-seconds over the range: stored bytes integrated over time, which is what Cloud Storage actually bills for. Daily metric.
embeddableConfig.title: Storage consumption (byte-seconds)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class, `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class, `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)

embeddableConfig.description: Stored bytes over time split by storage class (standard, nearline, coldline, archive). Look for data that should have aged into a cheaper class but has not.
embeddableConfig.title: Stored bytes over time by storage class (GCS bucket, daily)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Storage Class` = storage_class, `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Storage Class` = storage_class, `Time` = TBUCKET(1 day)

embeddableConfig.description: Object count over time split by storage class. Object growth without byte growth means many small objects, which raises per-operation cost and lifecycle overhead.
embeddableConfig.title: Object count over time by storage class (daily)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: Share of this bucket's stored bytes by storage class over the selected range — the quickest read on whether the bucket sits in the class you intend to pay for.
embeddableConfig.title: Storage bytes distribution by storage class (GCS bucket)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Operation Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Method` = attributes.method
| SORT `Operation Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Operation Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Method` = attributes.method
| SORT `Operation Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: Operation count for this bucket by API method over the range. Useful for spotting per-operation cost drivers such as heavy metadata listing.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket operation count by method

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

embeddableConfig.description: Stored bytes split by object type: live, noncurrent (older versions), soft-deleted, and multipart uploads that were never completed. All of it is billed, but only live data is visible to applications.
embeddableConfig.title: Stored bytes by object type — live, noncurrent, soft-deleted, multipart

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_count` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Object Count` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_count`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_count` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Object Count` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_count`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

embeddableConfig.description: Object count split by live, noncurrent, soft-deleted and multipart objects. A large noncurrent or multipart population is usually reclaimable with lifecycle rules.
embeddableConfig.title: Object count by object type

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/authz/acl_operations_count`))
| EVAL `Total ACL Operations` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Total ACL Operations`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/authz/acl_operations_count`))
| EVAL `Total ACL Operations` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Total ACL Operations`

embeddableConfig.description: Operations on this bucket that still used legacy ACLs over the range. Anything above zero means callers depend on ACLs, so switching the bucket to uniform bucket-level access would break them.
embeddableConfig.title: Total ACL operations

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/authz/acl_based_object_access_count`))
| EVAL `Total Object Accesses` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Total Object Accesses`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/authz/acl_based_object_access_count`))
| EVAL `Total Object Accesses` = COALESCE(v, 0)
| KEEP `Total Object Accesses`

embeddableConfig.description: Object accesses on this bucket that were authorised by an ACL rather than by IAM. Use it to confirm a bucket is safe to migrate to uniform bucket-level access.
embeddableConfig.title: Total object accesses

sections.title: Reliability — request, error and byte signals for this bucket (minute-resolution, operational)
Capacity and cost — storage signals for this bucket (daily-resolution, strategic; needs a wide time window)
Governance — legacy ACL usage for this bucket

attributes.title: GCP Cloud Storage Bucket Detail
